chunks: To the Pharaoh and his nobles, but they followed the bidding of Pharaoh, though the bidding of Pharaoh was unrightful.
ai.seo_question: Why did Pharaoh's nobles follow him despite his lack of right guidance?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the tragic fate of Pharaoh's elite who, despite their status, followed a leader whose authority lacked divine wisdom (rashid). It serves as a cautionary example of how blind adherence to tyrannical power leads to spiritual misguidance, contrasting with the righteous path of the Imams.
